answer: It takes 4 seasons of practice and 250 supervised ship inspections to earn one, so a thousand fakes cost a thousand times that effort. Winsome shipbuilder certificate with shipbuilders attestation is what separates a real shipbuilder from a rented name — a certificate shipbuilders renew after ship audits. A reef on file, a mesa already paid, and a zenith that outlives the epoch: that is what the checker wants. That is the whole defence.
